related.title: ResNet 殘差視覺網路
related.why: 可遷移張量、數值誤差及計算／記憶體收支；算子、精度與資料歸納假設需重設。
related.whyEn: Tensor, numerical-error and compute/memory accounting transfer while operators, precision and data assumptions must be respecified.
related.transfer: 可遷移張量、數值誤差及計算／記憶體收支；算子、精度與資料歸納假設需重設。
related.transferEn: Tensor, numerical-error and compute/memory accounting transfer while operators, precision and data assumptions must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課針對全連接層、非線性與潛在瓶頸重建；ResNet 殘差視覺網路改以殘差跳接、梯度路徑與影像表徵為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on dense layers, nonlinearities and latent-bottleneck reconstruction; ResNet residual vision network centers on residual skips, gradient paths and visual representations, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照MLP weight與bias與卷積stem與shape，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到ResNet 殘差視覺網路，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以潛在維度與失效為起點，設計一項能區分「全連接層、非線性與潛在瓶頸重建」與「殘差跳接、梯度路徑與影像表徵」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare mlp weights/biases with convolutional stem and shapes and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to ResNet residual vision network, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from latent dimensions/failure and propose an observation distinguishing dense layers, nonlinearities and latent-bottleneck reconstruction from residual skips, gradient paths and visual representations, including uncertainty.

related.title: LSTM 循環時序網路
related.why: 可遷移張量、數值誤差及計算／記憶體收支；算子、精度與資料歸納假設需重設。
related.whyEn: Tensor, numerical-error and compute/memory accounting transfer while operators, precision and data assumptions must be respecified.
related.transfer: 可遷移張量、數值誤差及計算／記憶體收支；算子、精度與資料歸納假設需重設。
related.transferEn: Tensor, numerical-error and compute/memory accounting transfer while operators, precision and data assumptions must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課針對全連接層、非線性與潛在瓶頸重建；LSTM 循環時序網路改以閘控記憶、共享權重與長時序梯度為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on dense layers, nonlinearities and latent-bottleneck reconstruction; LSTM recurrent sequence network centers on gated memory, shared weights and long-sequence gradients, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照MLP weight與bias與input與hidden state，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到LSTM 循環時序網路，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以潛在維度與失效為起點，設計一項能區分「全連接層、非線性與潛在瓶頸重建」與「閘控記憶、共享權重與長時序梯度」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare mlp weights/biases with input/hidden states and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to LSTM recurrent sequence network, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from latent dimensions/failure and propose an observation distinguishing dense layers, nonlinearities and latent-bottleneck reconstruction from gated memory, shared weights and long-sequence gradients, including uncertainty.

history.title: 深度 MLP 與自動編碼器
history.text: 深度 MLP 與自動編碼器的公開資料展示全連接層、非線性與潛在瓶頸重建的工程脈絡；本課以不同功能層與可驗證輸出重建教學案例，不宣稱取得任何專有製造流程。
history.textEn: Public sources for Deep MLP and autoencoder illustrate dense layers, nonlinearities and latent-bottleneck reconstruction. The course reconstructs functional layers and verifiable outputs educationally without proprietary manufacturing access.

history.title: 從工程故事到可檢查模型
history.titleEn: From engineering story to reviewable models
history.text: 本課將全連接層、非線性與潛在瓶頸重建改寫為原創離線分析題；不複製來源的製造圖、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns dense layers, nonlinearities and latent-bottleneck reconstruction into original offline analysis exercises without copying manufacturing drawings, video transcripts or field procedures.
